description.zh: 雨、咖啡厅、篝火与白噪，全部在卡片里现场合成，不带一个音频文件
description.en: Rain, café, fire and white noise, synthesized in the card itself with no audio files

items.zh: 点左边那个圆按钮才开始，再点一次就停。
items.en: Press the round button to start; press it again to stop.

items.zh: 卡片打开时是暂停的 —— 它不会自己出声。
items.en: It opens paused. It never starts making noise on its own.

items.zh: 卡片被收起来时声音继续；把卡片删掉，声音才停。
items.en: Hiding the card keeps the sound going; removing the card stops it.

items.zh: 雨：白噪过一道 1.2 kHz 低通，叠一层很慢的起伏。
items.en: Rain: white noise through a 1.2 kHz lowpass with a very slow swell.

items.zh: 咖啡厅：棕噪过带通，中心频率一直慢慢漂，像远处的人声。
items.en: Café: brown noise through a bandpass whose centre keeps drifting, like a distant crowd.

items.zh: 篝火：棕噪做底，随机掉出爆裂声。
items.en: Fire: brown noise as the bed, with crackles dropping in at random.

items.zh: 白噪：不做滤波，均匀掩蔽，适合挡掉说话声。
items.en: White: unfiltered and even, good for masking voices.

items.zh: 暂停时点场景只是换选，下一次播放从它开始。
items.en: While paused, picking a scene only selects it; the next play starts with it.

items.zh: 在滑杆上按住拖，或者聚焦后按方向键（Shift 更细，PageUp / PageDown 一大步）。
items.en: Drag the slider, or focus it and use the arrow keys (Shift for finer, PageUp / PageDown for bigger steps).

items.zh: 右边那个数字是百分数；0% 是静音，不是暂停。
items.en: The number on the right is a percentage; 0% is silence, not pause.

items.zh: 响度不是线性的：50% 听起来比线性滑杆的中间要轻。
items.en: Loudness is not linear: 50% sounds lighter than the middle of a linear slider.

items.zh: 四个场景都是 Web Audio 现场合成，包里没有一个 mp3。
items.en: All four scenes are synthesized with Web Audio; the package holds no mp3.

items.zh: 所以它没有联网权限，也不需要读你的音频文件。
items.en: So it asks for no network access and never reads your audio files.

items.zh: 唯一要的权限是存储，用来记住选的场景和音量。
items.en: The only permission it needs is storage, to remember the scene and volume.

items.zh: 场景和音量写在组件存储里，几张开着的卡片看得见彼此的选择。
items.en: Scene and volume live in widget storage, so open cards see each other's choice.

items.zh: 播放状态不记：下次打开仍然是暂停。
items.en: The playing state is not stored: next time it opens paused.

items.zh: 卡片被删掉时 AudioContext 随之释放，不会在后台留一个播放器。
items.en: Removing the card releases the AudioContext, so no player is left running in the background.

items.zh: 先看按钮：三角形 = 没在放，两根竖条 = 在放。
items.en: Look at the button first: a triangle means stopped, two bars mean playing.

items.zh: 系统音量、输出设备，以及 Windows 的「应用音量」都可能是 0。
items.en: The system volume, the output device and Windows' per-app volume can all be zero.

items.zh: 拿不到音频设备时，状态行会写「此环境没有音频输出」。
items.en: When no audio device is available the status line reads No audio output here.

changes.zh: 第一个版本：雨、咖啡厅、篝火、白噪四种场景，全部现场合成。
changes.en: First release: rain, café, fire and white noise, all synthesized on the spot.

changes.zh: 点一下出声，场景与音量记在组件存储里，播放状态不落盘。
changes.en: One click starts the sound; scene and volume are remembered, while the playing state is not.

changes.zh: 滑杆是自绘的，只为它 250ms 的篝火心跳在播放时才挂。
changes.en: The volume slider is hand-drawn, and the 250 ms heartbeat for fire crackles only runs while playing.
